The '''Kaminoan great staff''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] in the form of a [[Staff/Legends|staff]] [[Polearm/Legends|polearm]] used by the Kaminoans to detain clones during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but saw combat usage during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kaminoan great staffs appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
